response_text:
**Summary:**  
The building manager informs residents of the North Tower that the annual elevator maintenance will take place on Tuesday, October 21, from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. During this time, residents should use the stairs or the service (cargo) elevator in the South building. The manager apologizes for any inconvenience.
